def find_year(abbr):
    base_year = 1989
    year_length = len(abbr) - 4  # Remove 'IAO'' from the abbreviation
    year_str = abbr[4:]  # Extract the year digits
    year = int(year_str)
    
    while True:
        year_str = str(base_year + year)
        if len(year_str) > year_length:
            break
        if year_str[-year_length:] == year_str:
            return base_year + year
        year += 1

n = int(input())
abbreviations = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]

for abbr in abbreviations:
    print(find_year(abbr))
